name: Back To Cardio
overview:
Welcome to Back to cardio

Our new 100% cardio program! If you are a beginner or returning to sport and looking to improve your physical condition and cardio, burn calories and lose fat, Back to Cardio is the program for you!

We will accompany you throughout the program so that you master the basic cardio-training movements and obtain great results! Don't worry, the intensity will be gradual!

A simple, quick and effective program!

See you on the carpet!
